lineage.mechanism: A cheap first stage extracted objects/OCR/scene/screenshot signals and an explicit escalation engine routed low-confidence, ambiguous or semantically demanding cases to a heavier VLM.
lineage.inheritance: Direct architecture ancestor of the current familiar-fast-path versus deeper-perception rule. Historical routing was not user-adaptive learning and its confidence was heuristic rather than the current calibrated open-set contract.

lineage.mechanism: The prior detector/VLM split was removed and FrankEye combined saved Digital Retina v8 CNN state with DINOv2, fixed HOG/color features, OCR, faces and additional visual feature extraction in one local CPU module.
lineage.inheritance: Concrete proof that historical Retina mechanisms can be physically dissolved into a unified sensor module while retaining explicit internal feature/classifier state.

lineage.mechanism: The screenshot path later removed CIFAR-10 classification as useless for screenshot semantics and strengthened app/UI/OCR-specific processing.
lineage.inheritance: Negative-result value: generic closed-set labels must not be preserved merely because they are cheap; the current Micro Visual Classifier should learn user-relevant recurring classes and keep unknown/open-set semantics.

lineage.mechanism: FrankEye was subsequently replaced entirely by a Qwen3.5 native multimodal bridge; the new path explicitly removed the separate CNN/DINO/ONNX/Tesseract stack from visual analysis.
lineage.inheritance: Architecture supersession, not evidence that explicit familiarity learning became unnecessary. The native bridge contains no Project-Frankenstein user-specific prototype/classifier state, trust-tier admission, candidate promotion, rollback or open-set familiarity lifecycle.

drive_retina_already_known: Historical Digital Retina had a learned centroid/dictionary lineage and realistic-negative threshold calibration.
The Drive lineage already supports MVC-0 prototype/centroid familiarity, frozen replay and anti-Goodhart calibration, but lacked the current per-user trust/promotion/rollback contract.
new_project_frankenstein_delta: Project-Frankenstein shows how that Retina lineage entered a live integrated sensor module (FrankEye), rather than remaining only an evaluation/research tree.
Project-Frankenstein preserves an earlier cheap-first escalation mechanism that maps directly onto current known/familiar fast-path versus deeper-perception routing.

Project-Frankenstein also records a later complete native-multimodal replacement that discarded the explicit special-purpose Retina stack; this is a concrete lineage warning that physical unification can erase adaptive familiarity state unless its semantics are separately preserved.
The screenshot-specific CIFAR removal is a concrete domain-mismatch negative result that favors user-specific classes and open-set rejection over inherited generic closed-set labels.
cross_source_reconciliation.dedup_result: No duplicate earned-work hours are assigned. This receipt adds integration/supersession lineage and a new regression invariant rather than re-crediting the Drive prototype/dictionary work.

current_architecture_delta.meaning: Even if Qwen-class native vision becomes the deepest recognizer inside dissolved Retina, FRANK 0.1 still needs an explicit versioned user-specific familiarity layer with trusted-example lineage, open-set outcomes, bounded candidate updates and rollback/replay semantics.
current_architecture_delta.recommended_path: Preserve the historical cheap-first escalation idea, but insert the current Micro Visual Classifier before deep native multimodal interpretation: change gate -> frozen reusable feature -> user-specific prototype/readout -> calibrated known/unknown/conflict -> familiar fast path or deep native vision/Retina escalation.
do_not_reintroduce: CIFAR-10 labels as general screenshot semantics.
Historical heuristic escalation confidence as semantic authority.
A native multimodal description as proof of user-specific familiarity.
Historical VLM latency/save-rate comments as current measured performance without project-hardware receipts.

harness_implications: H1 visual replay should include a lineage regression test where native vision remains available but the Micro Visual Classifier state is lesioned; the build must fail the adaptive-learning acceptance contract despite still being able to describe images.
Compare MVC-0/MVC-1 fast-path routing against a deep-native-vision-only baseline on recurring user-specific classes, near-neighbor OOD and changed UI states.
Replay screenshot cases where generic closed-set classification conflicts with OCR/UI/context evidence and require UNKNOWN/CONFLICT or deep escalation rather than forced familiarity.
On feature-backbone migration, invalidate or explicitly migrate prototype/readout compatibility; never silently reuse stale familiarity vectors across incompatible embeddings.

recommended_discriminating_tests.design: Run the same recurring-user visual set with full MVC + native deep path versus native deep path with MVC state lesioned. Measure personalization gain, routing compute, open-set rejection and replay state. The lesion must show whether the familiarity layer contributes distinct functionality beyond generic multimodal recognition.

Replace the old heuristic confidence inputs with calibrated MVC known/unknown/conflict outcomes and compare deep-perception call rate and task loss against always-deep and old-style cheap-detector baselines.

Use screenshot/UI examples for which a generic visual label is technically plausible but operationally irrelevant; verify that user-specific class/prototype evidence and sensor context control routing and that low-support similarity cannot become KNOWN_HIGH_CONFIDENCE.
